name: Safe public status-card copy candidates for volatile DOJ SLS matters
nonclaim: These cards are copy drafts for a no-person department/source inventory. They do not admit public status claims.

cards.title: New Orleans Police Department — source-status conflict packet
cards.safe_public_copy: DOJ’s cases page currently indexes this matter with an Enforcement label, while later official and local sources report a November 19, 2025 termination of the consent decree. The cube has not yet frozen the terminal court order, so it displays this as a source-status reconciliation item rather than a current-status conclusion.

cards.title: Newark Police Department — source-status conflict packet
cards.safe_public_copy: DOJ’s cases page indexes Newark with an Enforcement label, while later official and monitor-adjacent sources report termination in November 2025. The cube has not frozen the terminal order/docket entry and therefore does not choose a current-status label.

cards.title: Seattle Police Department — aligned but still gated
cards.safe_public_copy: DOJ’s cases page and a later DOJ press release both point toward closure/termination signals for Seattle, and a federal court notice identifies the termination hearing. The cube still requires the final order/docket entry before publishing a current-status conclusion.
must_show_warnings: aligned signals are not order proof

cards.title: Cleveland Division of Police — motion signal only
cards.safe_public_copy: DOJ announced that it and Cleveland filed a motion to terminate the consent decree. A motion is not an order. The cube therefore keeps Cleveland in a motion-pending reconciliation lane until a post-motion court order is checked.

cards.title: Orange County — mixed parent row split required
cards.safe_public_copy: The source row combines the Orange County District Attorney’s Office and Orange County Sheriff’s Department. Rev0006 splits child status candidates so one agency’s completion or closure signal does not overwrite the other.

cards.title: Louisville / Minneapolis — federal closure with history-retention guard
cards.safe_public_copy: DOJ closure/retraction language is recorded as a dated federal event. Earlier public records—findings reports, complaints, proposed decrees, motions, and orders—remain historical carriers and are not erased by later federal posture.

cards.title: Press-release agencies absent from current source-row seed
cards.safe_public_copy: Some agencies named in a DOJ closure/retraction press release are not matched to the current 27-row source seed. The cube records ghost-carrier candidates rather than treating absence from the current page as absence of history.
